items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: And then another father, let's see what his name is. He's there too. His name was Jones.

ctx.x: Zooty Singleton. Zooty Singleton. Zooty. Yeah, Zooty. Yeah, that. I know him. Yeah. Yeah, I know him. He was born raised. That's the one I used to beat the stick on the side of the wall, because he got good out there. And then another father, let's see what his name is. He's there too. His name was Jones.
Let's see what his name is. He played drums? Yeah, drums.
